name: オブジェクト境界解析
algorithm: Object Boundary — ピクセルレベル空間分析
mechanism:
This method analyzes object boundary quality in video for deepfake detection:

1. **境界検出&分類**: Object boundaries are detected using edge detection and semantic segmentation. Boundaries are classified: person-background boundaries, clothing-skin boundaries, face feature boundaries (eyes, nose, mouth), and hair-background boundaries.

2. **境界Quality評価**: The quality of each boundary is measured: sharpness, smoothness, sub-pixel anti-aliasing. Natural boundaries have consistent quality across the frame (same optical system). Deepfake composites may show different boundary quality between generated face regions and original footage.

3. **Person-Background境界分析**: The boundary between the person and background is particularly informative. In authentic video, this boundary shows consistent optical properties. In composited deepfakes, the person-background boundary may show: matting artifacts (alpha channel errors), fringing, or resolution mismatches.

4. **時間的境界安定性**: Object boundaries should be temporally stable and move smoothly. The method tracks boundary positions and quality across frames. AI-generated boundaries may exhibit sub-pixel jitter, temporal instability, or motion artifacts not present in authentically captured boundaries.

5. **境界周波数分析**: The spatial frequency content at object boundaries encodes the imaging pipeline's optical characteristics. The method analyzes boundary frequency profiles — different capture/generation pipelines produce different boundary frequency signatures. Mismatched boundary profiles between face and background indicate compositing.
parameters:
分析タイプ: ピクセル
メディア: 動画
入力: Video frames extracted at key intervals
出力: 信頼度スコア (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: 中〜高 — 70-88% 単独精度. Most effective when combined with other 動画 forensic methods. Performance depends on 動画 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 動画 through object boundary analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 動画 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 動画 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 動画 forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by 動画 compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
• Best used as part of a comprehensive multi-method pipeline
• May produce false positives on heavily edited authentic 動画
